as_told.title: Baiting UFOs with nuclear material and downing them with directed energy

plain: Insiders on a Pentagon-funded study of UFOs, called AAWSAP, are said to have thought about luring UFOs with nuclear material. Michels tells this twice, citing a book by Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who has spoken out about UFOs. The second time, Michels names the book as Imminent and adds that the plan was to then bring the craft down with directed energy beams and high-powered radar.
